'''Dobra''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Dobra owned a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] that was stolen by [[Skip tracer/Legends|skip tracer]], stranding the [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] on [[Reuss VI]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
